text:
Elena: quick note from oncall this morning 1: operators couldn't trace a fallback to an audit row. The rollout card just says 'degraded' with no way to click through.
Sam: saw that. infra emits decision payloads, but console drops the event id for safety. we need a compromise for traceability.
Priya: we had a small prototype called the 'Why?' flyout that shows rule + trigger + example. still in figma.
Elena: backend currently returns a payload like `{"decision":"fallback","reason":"cache_miss","event_id":"evt_1748809999"}` but security asked to avoid surfacing raw event ids.
Mike: can't lose correlation. propose a short-lived trace token that maps to the audit row, ACL-checked on access. icon to indicate internal-only.
Sam: infra can emit `trace_token` and `sample_rate` and `trigger_counts`. example: `{"trace_token":"tkn_abc123","sample_rate":0.1,"trigger_counts":{"cache_miss":5}}` 1. trace_token contains no prompt/PII.
Priya: UI: rollout header shows `Fallbacks: 5 sampled / 27 total` with a tooltip about sampling. the flyout lists: rule name, trigger, sample flag, sample index, and one sanitized snippet (first 40 chars + 0...).
Elena: also our degrade labels are noisy. ops kept asking what 'soft-cut' meant. suggest canonical names: "Graceful" (reduce quality), "Failover" (switch model/region), "Silent" (drop to cached response). short one-liners under labels.
Mike: fine by product. please pair with icons (clock, shield, ghost) and short copy.
Sam: implementation note: we'll store mapping hash(event_id)->event_id in audit DB, mint trace_token = HMAC(hash, ttl=24h). clicking the token endpoint requires auth and checks ACL then redirects to audit row.
Priya: for privacy, sample examples must be sanitized: no more than 40 chars of user text, remove special chars, redact emails/keys. show `sanitized_example` field from backend.
Elena: Ops asked for a small trigger histogram in the rollout details so they can see spikes.
Sam: I can add a /rollouts/:id/telemetry/histogram endpoint returning small bins + top triggers per bin. ETA: trace_token + counts by Thu EOD, histogram next Tue.
Priya: i'll deliver flyout mocks Tue and a feature-flagged branch Wed for internal beta. will include microcopy for the new labels.
Mike: need a QA-only "replay" action on the audit row so SEs can reproduce fallback behavior. gated behind internal role.
Sam: replay will be internal-only and rate-limited. will require an audit justification param.
OpsBot: audit service mapped evt_1748809999 -> https://audit.redwood/evt_1748809999 (access requires SSO and role check). :lock:
Elena: action items: Sam -> add trace_token, counts, histogram endpoint. Priya -> mocks + label copy + flyout. Mike -> final signoff on labels and gating for replay.
Sam: Thu 4pm sync for handoff?
Priya: works for me.
Mike: +1.
Elena: thanks team. goal: ship feature-flagged beta next week to a small operator cohort.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Priya: :heart:
